subject: Cognitive Science
title: False Dilemma
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on False Dilemma.

hook.text: "You're either with us or against us." But what about partly agreeing? Middle ground just disappeared.

buildup.text: A false dilemma presents only two options when more exist. It forces a choice between extremes.

discovery.text: It works by hiding the middle. Most real issues are spectrums, not either/or binaries.

twist.text: Politicians love it: "cut taxes or destroy the economy." The real options include dozens of tax structures.

climax.text: The fix: ask "are those really the only options?" Usually a third, fourth, or fifth path exists.

punchline.text: Two choices is rarely the real number.

quiz.question: What is a false dilemma?
options: Presenting only two options when more exist
A genuine dilemma with no good option

details.summary: A false dilemma presents only two options when more exist. You are either with us or against us ignores neutrality, partial agreement, and alternative positions. This fallacy narrows thinking by eliminating middle ground and nuance from complex issues that rarely have only two sides.
details.whyItMatters: False dilemmas are powerful rhetorical weapons that force premature commitment by hiding the full range of available positions.
takeaways: Most issues have more than two possible positions
False dilemmas eliminate middle ground and nuance
Always ask: are there other options not being presented?

faq.question: How do you counter a false dilemma?
faq.answer: Identify the missing options. When someone says you must choose A or B, ask what about C, D, or a combination? Showing that additional viable options exist dissolves the false dilemma immediately. Most complex issues have a spectrum of positions, not two extremes.

faq.question: Why are false dilemmas so persuasive?
faq.answer: They simplify complex decisions into easy either-or choices. Our brains prefer simple frames. Politicians and advertisers exploit this: framing a nuanced policy issue as a clear binary makes their preferred option seem like the only reasonable choice. Simplicity is seductive.
